text.p: Following are the main stories in Slovenia's Tuesday morning newspapers:

- Italian president Oscar Luigi Scalfaro expressed support during his visit to Slovenia for Slovenia's efforts to join NATO in the first wave. He met his counterpart Milan Kucan and Premier Janez Drnovsek.
- Drnovsek and Foreign Minister Zoran Thaler will attend a two-day NATO summit in Madrid.
- Employees of commercial television station TV 3 continue their strike for the 18th day, demanding payment of salaries for the last six months.
- Finance Minister Mitja Gaspari attended a meeting of EU finance ministers and 10 associate members of the union to talk about the coordination of macroeconomic policies of future member states.
- Drnovsek met Slovenian archbishop Franc Rode on Monday to talk about improvement of relations between the state and the church.
- Special diving rescue team postponed the search for a police diver who got lost in the underground lake Divje jezero a month ago. Rescuers said they will continue their work in August.
- The Defence Ministry has still not disclosed information about the suicides of two soldiers last week.
